description: Generic form field wrapper providing a label (with optional required marker), help text, error message display, and a slot for any form control. Supports automatic EditContext validation via the ValidationFor parameter — when inside an EditForm, errors from the validation system appear automatically. Applies error styling whenever an error is active (from ErrorMessage or EditContext).

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Label text displayed above the field.

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: When true, a required asterisk is appended to the label.

parameters.name: HelpText
parameters.description: Helper text shown below the field when there is no error.

parameters.name: ErrorMessage
parameters.description: Explicit validation error message shown below the field in red. Takes precedence over EditContext validation. By default the message carries role="alert"; the AnnounceError="false" opt-out drops only the role, while the input-level AnnounceError (e.g. TmTextInput.AnnounceError) mutes only the wrapped control's own error message.

parameters.name: AnnounceError
parameters.description: When true (default), the rendered error message carries role="alert" so screen readers announce it assertively. Set false when the host moves focus to the invalid control itself: the error is then read through aria-describedby on the wrapped control and the live region would announce the same text twice. With false the message still renders, keeps its error styling and its stable ErrorId; only the role attribute is dropped.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Base DOM id used to derive the stable ErrorId ("{Id}-field-error"). The suffix differs from the inputs' {Id}-error so the ids of a field and its wrapped input never collide when they share the same Id. Defaults to a per-instance generated id.

parameters.name: ValidationFor
parameters.description: Expression identifying the model field to track for EditContext validation errors.

parameters.name: For
parameters.description: Value for the label's for attribute to associate it with a form control.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: When true, the field is disabled.

cascadingParameters.name: EditContext
cascadingParameters.description: Automatically received from a parent EditForm. Required for ValidationFor to work.

examples.title: Form field with label and help text
examples.code:
<TmFormField Label="Username" Required="true" HelpText="Must be at least 3 characters." For="username">
    <input id="username" type="text" @bind="model.Username" />
</TmFormField>

examples.title: Form field with explicit error message
Form field with automatic EditContext validation
examples.code:
<EditForm Model="@_model" OnValidSubmit="HandleSubmit">
    <DataAnnotationsValidator />

    <TmFormField Label="Name" Required="true" ValidationFor="@(() => _model.Name)" For="name">
        <TmTextInput id="name" @bind-Value="_model.Name" />
    </TmFormField>

    <TmFormField Label="Age" Required="true" ValidationFor="@(() => _model.Age)">
        <TmNumberInput @bind-Value="_model.Age" Min="0" Max="150" />
    </TmFormField>

    <TmButton Type="ButtonType.Submit">Save</TmButton>
</EditForm>

examples.title: Form field with FluentValidation and automatic errors
examples.code:
<EditForm Model="@_model" OnValidSubmit="HandleSubmit">
    <FluentValidationValidator />

    <TmFormField Label="Department" Required="true" ValidationFor="@(() => _model.Department)">
        <TmSelect TValue="string" @bind-Value="_model.Department"
            Options="@_departmentOptions" Placeholder="Select department" />
    </TmFormField>
</EditForm>

examples.title: Form field whose submit focuses the first invalid control
examples.code:
<TmFormField Label="Amount" ValidationFor="@(() => _model.Amount)" AnnounceError="false" For="amount">
    <TmTextInput id="amount" @bind-Value="_model.Amount" />
</TmFormField>
<!-- The error still renders (id="{Id}-field-error") and stays linked through the wrapped control's aria-describedby; only role="alert" is dropped, so it is not announced twice when focus already moved to the field. -->

notes: ValidationFor and ErrorMessage can coexist — ErrorMessage always takes precedence when non-empty.
Without ValidationFor the component behaves identically to the original version — fully backward compatible.
Uses Expression<Func<object>> (same as TmFormValidationMessage) so no type parameter is needed at the call site.

The error paragraph gets a stable DOM id (ErrorId = "{Id}-field-error", Id defaults to a per-instance generated id; the suffix differs from the inputs' {Id}-error so the two never collide). While it renders, the id is published to the wrapped content as a cascading value named TmFormFieldErrorId — the cascade reaches every Tm input inside the field's content, and each of those inputs adds it to its own aria-describedby (after the input's help text) when the input has no own Error.
